text: {"lessons":["With prices moving randomly, recent gains or losses do not tell me what comes next; I should avoid trading just to react to them.","I should base each decision on the portfolio’s overall risk and diversification, not on whether a position is above or below my average cost.","My reluctance to realize losses and satisfaction from locking in gains can distort judgment, so I should follow a consistent plan rather than let those feelings dictate trades."]}
